verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a built-in AI assistant that answers questions, troubleshoots, explores telemetry in plain language, and helps fix NRQL queries (docs-9, docs-10). It also ships an in-product vulnerability agent that triages CVEs, drafts remediation steps, and opens Jira/GitHub issues (docs-41, docs-49), plus AI workload insights (docs-43). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the assistant works as described, detailed docs on what multi-step tasks the general assistant can execute beyond Q&A, and documentation behind the 'automated remediation' marketing claim (docs-46).
